description: Recorded deviations between the pinned source transcription and the printed primary source, plus the claims this work explicitly does not make.

deviations.decision: the reference keeps the source multiplication order; the activation is evaluated with -expm1(-x) so the near-boundary family is mathematically exact, and that family carries an explicit per-case band max(1e-9, 1e-15/eps) that covers the phase-realization resolution of the wrapped source phase instead of widening the global rtol
deviations.topic: numerical evaluation order and the near-boundary cancellation regime

deviations.decision: the reference asserts the SHA-256 pin together with the normalization state, so a checkout without the eol=lf guarantee fails with an explicit message instead of an opaque digest mismatch

deviations.tested_by: the pinned-source hash test in the reference suite

provenance: contract-derived analytic constants (not frozen implementation behavior); a disagreement with any implementation is adjudicated, never edited in.
